places.name: The Motel Office
places.design: A cramped, wood-paneled motel office, aged and worn. Colors are muted browns and teal-grey shadows. On the worn wooden counter: a leather-bound guest book, an old brass desk bell, a dark wood fountain pen. A single, aged desk lamp with an amber-tinted glass shade provides the only direct light at night, its bulb dim and prone to flickering. Outside the large front window, the sodium-vapor parking lot lights cast a sickly yellow-orange glow. The room is perpetually cold.

places.name: The Motel Exterior
places.design: Outside: A single-story, low-slung motel with a long, straight row of identical, weathered pale green doors under a flat overhang. The yellow soffit lighting is weak and uneven. A single, brighter warm-yellow lamp glows in the front office window. The narrow two-lane asphalt road stretches into thick, damp fog. A 'WAYSIDE MOTEL' sign is old and faded. The night is still and foggy.
